sources.title: How to Redo Things with Words: Deniability and the Determinants of Illocutionary Force

sources.author: Elisabeth Camp
sources.title: Insinuation, Common Ground, and the Conversational Record
sources.format: author-hosted corrected-proof PDF via web text extraction
sources.locations: Printed pp. 50 and 58–61; PDF pages 11 and 19–22
sources.checked_claims: Admissibility depends on prior conversational commitments; actual liability can differ from current shared assumptions; recordings can supply otherwise missing evidence; on-record content may still exhibit deniability.

sources.limitations: Bounded pages only; no check of all examples or final published pagination.

sources.author: Chris Cousens
sources.title: Tweet Acts and Quote-Tweetable Acts
sources.locations: §4, especially discussion of score/common ground, fabricated promise, and predictive family

sources.limitations: Section 4 checked; no full independent evaluation of the account or its other examples.

sources.title: On Deniability
